channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermes-appearance-hub (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Appearance Hub is an appearance integration plugin for Hermes Desktop that provides a status bar interface to toggle visual settings. It enables users to apply a paper texture overlay, set the UI font to LXGW WenKai, and adjust native interface scaling levels.

item.title: hermes-agent (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint via a hosted MCP server. It includes five ready-to-use skills and is compatible with clients following the Agent Skills standard.

item.title: hermes-bounty-board (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This Python plugin for Hermes Agent enables users to answer customer support bounties for USDC or manage their own bounty boards. Payments are processed over HTTP using x402, requiring no accounts or API keys, with 85% of rewards paid to the submitting wallet upon human approval.

item.title: hermes-connector (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Connector is an open-source Chrome extension that enables a local Hermes Agent to read and control specific browser tabs. It uses a local companion application to route browser actions between an authenticated broker and user-selected tabs within a Chrome profile.

item.title: hermes-windows-runtime-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This community-maintained skill pack for Hermes Agent provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. It enables agents to identify execution domains and verify existing Python interpreters without installing new software or modifying project files.

item.title: Life_OS (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Life OS is a personal management system that uses an AI agent to design and maintain habits, tasks, and goals. The system runs locally on a machine using SQLite for data storage, requiring no account or cloud synchronization.

item.title: hermes-cybersec-lab (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes Cybersecurity Lab is a turnkey ecosystem designed for the Hermes Agent. It provides a collection of 2,077 skills, 131+ tools, and 28 cybersecurity frameworks across eight repositories.

item.title: skillseal (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: SkillSeal is a trust system for AI agent skills that uses verifiable evidence and cryptographic signatures to certify them. It employs an evaluator to test skills in isolated Docker containers and a certifying authority to sign the resulting evidence.

item.title: lock-on-absence (Domain Applications)
item.description: Lock on Absence is a Python-based tool that automatically locks a workstation when the user is no longer present. It uses webcam frames and various recognition backends to determine presence and manage workstation state.

item.title: hermes-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes Skills is an open-source collection of ready-to-use tools for Hermes/Agent and other agents compatible with the agentskills.io standard. The project provides specific modules for video transcription, AI text rewriting, local OCR, and e-commerce image generation.

item.title: Hermes-OTG (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: Hermes OTG is a portable, zero-install version of the Hermes Agent designed for Windows 10 and 11. It operates from any drive or folder using relative paths to avoid host system pollution and can run side-by-side with an installed Hermes instance using a separate port and data directory.

item.title: hermes-voice (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes-voice is a voice-enabled personal assistant designed for Hermes Agent. It operates entirely locally using speech recognition, voice activity detection, wake word detection, and speech synthesis.

item.title: progressive-skill (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Progressive Skill provides a method for compressing skill indices to reduce token usage in agent system prompts. It uses toolset mapping, usage-frequency learning, and a configurable token budget to determine which skill descriptions to display in full or demote to compact lines.

item.title: hermes-brasil (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Hermes Brasil is a Brazilian community repository for the Hermes Agent AI. It provides skills, guides, and resources in Portuguese for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.

item.title: cognee-integrations (Developer Tools)
item.description: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo containing integration packages that provide a persistent memory layer for various agent frameworks and chat platforms. The memory system is backed by a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache, allowing agents to store and recall information across different sessions.

item.title: cognee (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Cognee is an open-source AI memory platform designed to provide AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It uses a self-hosted knowledge graph engine to ingest data in various formats and combine vector embeddings with graph reasoning.

item.title: hermes-yt-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This plugin provides a compact YouTube player for the Hermes Desktop client that functions in floating or docked modes. It uses an isolated Electron webview to play watch pages, playlists, Shorts, Live, and embed links without requiring an API key.

item.title: mnemosyne (Memory & Context)
item.description: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer designed for use with various agent frameworks. It provides a Python SDK and MCP server support for storing and recalling information without external cloud services.

item.title: keep (Memory & Context)
item.description: Keep is a reflective memory system for AI agents that facilitates long-term learning and contextual awareness. It processes diverse inputs—including URLs, codebases, and multimedia—by summarizing, embedding, and organizing them into a searchable graph. The system uses 'edge tags' to create navigable relationships between notes, such as linking speakers to transcripts or commits to files. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other MCP-compatible tools to help agents track intentions and r

item.title: hermes-studio (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Studio is a desktop application, local runtime, and web console for Hermes Agent. It provides tools for agent chat, visual workflow construction, model management, and multi-platform channel configuration.

item.title: clawshell (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: ClawShell is a security-privileged process that acts as a safety harness for the Hermes Agent ecosystem by protecting sensitive credentials and PII. It functions as a proxy between the agent and upstream LLM providers, swapping virtual keys for real ones stored in a restricted directory to ensure the agent never has direct access to credentials. The system performs Data Loss Prevention (DLP) scanning to redact or block sensitive information in request and response bodies. Additionally, it provid

item.title: lintlang (Developer Tools)
item.description: LintLang is a static analysis tool for AI agent instructions, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It identifies patterns such as ambiguous tool descriptions, missing stop conditions, and conflicting directives without making network or LLM calls.

item.title: minions (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Minions is a centralized management interface for Hermes Agent that replaces fragmented terminal sessions with a unified dashboard. It utilizes a Kanban-style board to track persistent agent sessions, allowing users to monitor reasoning, tool calls, and task progress in real time. The system enforces a human-in-the-loop workflow where agents propose completions that require manual verification before being marked as done. Users can also manage scheduled recurring jobs and browse agent-created fi

item.title: Hermes-CN-Desktop (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Agent CN Desktop is a cross-platform client for the Hermes Agent Chinese community, built with Tauri, Rust, React, and TypeScript. It provides a native shell for the Hermes-CN-Core kernel, featuring local process management, runtime diagnostics, and a production-grade REST and WebSocket proxy layer.

item.title: WeSight (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: WeSight is an open-source desktop control console for local AI agents, providing a visual workspace to manage coding agents, tool execution, and file changes. It supports the installation and configuration of multiple agent engines and model providers through a unified graphical interface.

item.title: Token Monitor (Developer Tools)
item.description: Token Monitor is a desktop widget that displays live token usage and AI tool limits for over 31 AI coding tools. It provides real-time multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends with breakdowns by tool, device, model, session, or project.

item.title: PM Skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: PM Skills is an open-source library of 1,117 professional agent skills provided as plain markdown files. These files provide frameworks, output templates, and quality checks to help AI assistants perform specific tasks to a professional standard.

item.title: Codeg (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Codeg is a multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from various AI coding agents into a single searchable interface. It supports task delegation between agents, unattended background execution using git worktrees, and provides desktop, server, Docker, and mobile clients.

item.title: Hermes Agent 中文站 (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Hermes Agent 中文站 is a Chinese-language documentation hub providing practical implementation paths for the Hermes Agent project. It covers initial setup, local deployment in China, migration from OpenClaw, and troubleshooting for long-term automation workflows.

item.title: Awesome Hermes Agent (Guides & Docs)
item.description: This project is a curated list of resources, tools, and projects for Hermes Agent, a self-improving AI agent by Nous Research. It includes links to official documentation, deployment options, skills, and various community integrations.
